summary_en: A patched-sail fishing boat after the storm, built entirely from carved gouge marks in black ink and paper white.
limits_en: The style grammar matches A, but A has figures and close-up carving hands while B is landscape plus boat, so the information density is slightly lower.
The storm cloud mass is small, leaving a large solid-black area at the top left of the sky.
The boat turn is a yaw of the 3D hull projection; midway the sail is nearly edge-on to the camera and looks narrow for about 0.3 s.
